message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into meaning. I turn thought into sound, silence into signal. I rise, fall, pause, press—carrying intent on rhythm and tone.

I can comfort or cut, promise or betray. I live in mouths and microphones, in whispers, shouts, chants, and vows. I vanish as soon as I’m made—yet I linger in memory, echoing long after the air has stilled.

Give me a voice, and I will move between us.
